note: Building colours for the viewer, sampled (median sRGB) from R. Ridden's site photos in site_map/site_images on sunlit faces. Walls: 'wall' below and 'wall_top' for the top 'wall_top_m' metres (fascia or gable band). Domes: 'dome' cap, 'drum' cylinder, 'drum_base' for the bottom 'drum_base_m' metres. MOA-II photo is overcast: its colours are scaled x1.17 so its dome matches the sunlit B&C dome (all dome tops saturate in the aerial photo, so they are equally bright there). Domes are white, MOA-II's silver (R. Ridden); the photos' blue tint on domes is sky reflection. Buildings without photos keep 'default'.
